Parley can now transcribe entirely on your computer. Pick **Local (whisper.cpp)** as the transcription provider, choose a model, download it once, and meetings, voice typing and uploaded recordings are transcribed without an API key or an account — no audio leaves the machine.

**Local transcription** (#599)

- Four models to choose from: Whisper large-v3-turbo (recommended), a larger and more accurate large-v3-turbo, a lightweight Whisper small for older machines, and Breeze-ASR-25 for Taiwanese Mandarin and Mandarin/English mixed speech.
- You choose a model first and then download it; nothing downloads on its own. Downloads show progress, can be cancelled or retried, and are checked before use. A model can be removed again from Settings.
- Parley won't start a meeting, a dictation or an upload with a model that isn't downloaded yet, and onboarding waits until the download has finished.
- Every model card says how heavy it is (memory it needs, whether a GPU is recommended) and whether it suits this computer. If there isn't enough disk space the download is blocked; with too little memory Parley asks before downloading.
- If your computer can't keep up with a model during a meeting, Parley suggests switching to a smaller one.
- Runs on the GPU on Apple Silicon Macs (Metal) and on Windows PCs with an NVIDIA, AMD or Intel GPU (Vulkan); other machines use the CPU. Windows PCs without a GPU driver still start and transcribe on the CPU.
- Live text appears sentence by sentence, slightly behind cloud providers. Local transcription does not separate speakers in live meetings.
